title: Paris Afro Latin Congress 2027
description:
🔥 PARIS AFRO LATIN CONGRESS 2027 – DELUXE EDITION 🔥
✨ 19–22 MARCH 2027 | PARIS, FRANCE ✨
Get ready for an extraordinary weekend at the Paris Afro Latin Congress – Deluxe Edition 2027! ❤️‍🔥
A unique celebration bringing together the best of Bachata, Kizomba, Salsa and Brazilian Zouk for an unforgettable international dance experience.
🌟 BACHATA ARTISTS
Ronald y Alba • Elwin y Gaby • Borja y Lydia • Luis y Sara • Samy El Mágico • Reda • Laia de la Fuente • Dmitry • Ezo y Hugo • Adil y Elo • Cyril y Maeva • David y Natasha • JLO
🔥 KIZOMBA ARTISTS
Fred Nelson y Morgane • Ichigo y Kristel • Fabricio y Mame • Valyr y Sarah • Lydia Laprade • Enora y Pidjay • Beepee y Marta • Zino • Jonathan Kani • DJ Paraiso • DJ Nao • DJ Snakes • DJ Do Zangado • DJ Diablo • DJ Ichigo • DJ JDN
💃 SALSA ARTISTS
Philippe Gomis • Rudy Fabre • Alex Salserito • Minou • DJ Chanchan • DJ Phil • DJ Alex
🌴 BRAZILIAN ZOUK ARTISTS
Alex de Carvalho • Simba y Manon • DJ Simbocop
🏨 ALL IN ONE EXPERIENCE
Hosted at the Paris Marriott Charles de Gaulle Airport Hotel, bringing together workshops, artists, socials and parties all in one place.
✨ 4 DAYS • 4 DANCE STYLES • INTERNATIONAL ARTISTS • WORKSHOPS • PARTIES • SOCIALS
Whether you’re passionate about Bachata, Kizomba, Salsa or Brazilian Zouk, Paris Afro Latin Congress 2027 is the perfect place to dance, connect and experience an unforgettable weekend with the international dance community.
🔥 PARIS IS CALLING. ARE YOU READY?
📅 19–22 March 2027
📍 Paris Marriott Charles de Gaulle Airport Hotel – Paris, France
